question: How many Rajya Sabha seats come from the state of Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **7 **Rajya Sabha seats come from the state of Assam.
 
• The Number of Members of the Rajya Sabha to be elected from Each States/Union Territory has been fixed by the Fourth Schedule of the Constitution.
 
• In India, the seats of states/Union territory are dependent on the Larger Size of the population get more Representatives seats than the states with Smaller Populations.
